grammar.q: The earthquake ____ hit Taiwan yesterday morning was terrible.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是物（地震），關代當主詞不可省

grammar.q: I like the girl ____ brown hair. She has a beautiful smile.
grammar.tip: girl 是人、單數 → who has

grammar.q: The only thing ____ interests Molly is music.
grammar.tip: 先行詞有 the only 修飾 → 用 that

grammar.q: The woman ____ the yellow dress is my mother.
grammar.tip: in + 衣著：穿著黃色洋裝

grammar.q: The dog ____ is playing with a ball is Amanda's pet.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是動物，關代當主詞 → that

grammar.q: The boy ____ is wearing a hat is my brother.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是人，關代當主詞不可省 → who

grammar.q: Let's help that man who ____ only one leg.
grammar.tip: who 代替 man（單數）→ has

grammar.q: The flowers ____ put in the vase were picked ____ my grandma this morning.
grammar.tip: 花是被放的 → that were put；被動用 by

grammar.q: Most people ____ live in this building are nice and friendly.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是人，關代當主詞 → who

grammar.q: Do you know the man ____ is standing in front of the school?
grammar.tip: 人當先行詞可用 who/that，不可省略

grammar.q: Look at the man ____ a baby. Is he Kate's husband?
grammar.tip: 男人主動抱嬰兒 → who is holding

grammar.q: Linda dreamed of living in a beautiful apartment ____ a great view.
grammar.tip: with + 特徵：有美景的公寓

grammar.q: The boxes ____ to Shawn's sisters are pink.
grammar.tip: 需關代；boxes 複數 → which belong

grammar.q: The dog ____ is lying on the sofa bit Elva yesterday.
grammar.tip: 動物當先行詞、關代當主詞 → that

grammar.q: The man with glasses ____ like my cousin Jimmy.
grammar.tip: 主詞是 The man（單數）→ looks

grammar.q: Patty knows the kid ____ a dog as a pet.
grammar.tip: kid 是人、單數 → who keeps

grammar.q:
A: Is this the painting ____ yesterday?
B: Yes. The police found it a few hours ago.
grammar.tip: 畫被弄丟、單數、過去 → that was lost

grammar.q: The books ____ written by Alice Walker are on sale.
grammar.tip: books 複數、是物 → that were written

grammar.q:
A: Who's that person ____ the black shirt?
B: He's my uncle.
grammar.tip: in + 衣著：穿黑襯衫的人

grammar.q: Have you tried the pies ____ made by Grandma? They are yummy.
grammar.tip: pies 複數、被做 → which were made

grammar.q: The woman who ____ asked me where the nearest metro station was.
grammar.tip: who 後要接動詞；woman 單數 → was

grammar.q: Rachel only uses notebooks ____ used paper.
grammar.tip: 筆記本由舊紙做成 → that were made of

grammar.q: The cat ____ blue eyes is Tina's.
grammar.tip: with + 身體特徵：有藍眼睛的貓

grammar.q: That's the man ____ talked to me in the supermarket yesterday.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是人、關代當主詞 → who

grammar.q: They live in the house ____ a century ago.
grammar.tip: 房子是被蓋的 → that was built

grammar.q: The apartment ____ four bedrooms ____ big enough for a family of three.
grammar.tip: with 片語修飾；apartment 單數 → is

grammar.q: Who is the singer ____ has a beautiful voice?
grammar.tip: 關代當主詞不可省；人 → that/who

grammar.q: The party ____ by Mr. and Mrs. Paul last night was fun.
grammar.tip: 派對是被舉辦的 → which was held

grammar.q: Ryan didn't like the dish ____ was made of fish.
grammar.tip: 關代當主詞不可省 → that

grammar.q: The book ____ by a famous writer is about special buildings in the world.
grammar.tip: 書是被寫的、物 → which is written

grammar.q: Do you know the man ____ over there? He is Lisa's cousin from Canada.
grammar.tip: in + 衣著：穿黑夾克的男人

grammar.q: Dino's is the restaurant ____ is famous for their steak and good service.
grammar.tip: 關代在子句中當主詞 → which

grammar.q: The students like the teacher ____ always wears a smile on his face.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是人、關代當主詞 → who

grammar.q: The horse ____ ran the fastest is Lucky.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是動物 → which

grammar.q: Those children who ____ playing video games in the room are my sons.
grammar.tip: who 代替 children（複數）→ are

grammar.q: The girl ____ is speaking in the front of the classroom is our class leader.
grammar.tip: 人當先行詞、關代當主詞 → who

grammar.q: Miss Wang is the lady ____ long straight hair.
grammar.tip: with + 外表特徵：留長直髮

grammar.q: Jenny is driving the car ____ belongs to me.
grammar.tip: 物當先行詞、關代當主詞 → that

grammar.q:
A: Who's that boy ____ a pink T-shirt?
B: Oh, that's my brother, Matthew.
grammar.tip: in + 衣著：穿粉紅 T 恤

grammar.q: The reporter is going to interview a man ____ the new machine.
grammar.tip: 人主動發明機器 → who created

grammar.q:
A: I need to do a report on nuclear power, but I don't know how to do it.
B: Don't worry. I have a book ____ it.
grammar.tip: about + 內容：關於核能的書

grammar.q: Tai Tzuying is a world-famous badminton player ____ comes from Taiwan.
grammar.tip: 先行詞是人、關代當主詞 → who

grammar.q: Can anyone who knows the answer ____ it out loud?
grammar.tip: Can + 主詞 + 原形動詞 → say

grammar.q: I like to read comic books ____ me laugh.
grammar.tip: comic books 複數 → that make

fix.t: All the excuses Nick [[made]] [[which say]] a lot about how much he [[hates to do]] the job.
fix.tip: Nick made 前省略了關代，句子還缺主要動詞，應直接接 say

fix.t: The police [[haven't found]] the little girl who [[has taken away]] at a supermarket. They'll [[keep doing]] all they can to find her.
fix.tip: 女孩是「被」帶走的，且是過去發生 → was taken away

fix.t: Scott wasn't sure [[if]] the young woman [[before him]] was [[the one]] pulled him out of a car on fire.
fix.tip: the one 後面接動詞 pulled，需要關代 who 連接

fix.t: Students [[want]] to go on the school trip [[should ask]] [[their parents]] first.
fix.tip: 句中已有動詞 should ask，修飾 Students 要用 who want

fix.t: I [[thought]] the girl [[answered the phone]] was Kate, but it was [[her sister]], Candy. They sounded almost the same.
fix.tip: 子句不能有兩個動詞，修飾 the girl 需關代 who

fix.t: Little Eric chose the doll [[in]] big brown eyes [[because]] it was [[the cutest]] in the store.
fix.tip: 身體特徵用 with：有棕色大眼睛的娃娃

fix.t: Do you [[know]] [[the girls]] who [[is]] singing on the stage?
fix.tip: who 代替 the girls（複數），動詞要用 are

fix.t: The box [[of]] apples [[are]] for Grandma, so please [[don't eat]] any.
fix.tip: 主詞是 The box（單數），of apples 只是修飾 → is

fix.t: Do you know the woman [[who she]] is [[talking to]] Mr. Lin? She [[looks]] familiar.
fix.tip: who 已當子句主詞，後面不能再加 she

fix.t: The man [[lives]] next door [[often helps]] us [[carry]] heavy boxes.
fix.tip: 已有動詞 helps，修飾 The man 須加關代 who

fix.t: Mr. Chen is [[one of the]] teachers who really [[cares]] about students, so everyone [[likes]] him.
fix.tip: who 的先行詞是 teachers（複數）→ care

fix.t: Amy [[is talking]] [[with]] the boy [[which]] won the race yesterday.
fix.tip: 先行詞 the boy 是人，關代用 who，不用 which

fix.t: Tom [[bought]] a new phone [[who]] can [[take]] great pictures.
fix.tip: 先行詞 phone 是物，關代用 which/that

fix.t: Who is the boy [[in]] a big nose? He [[is standing]] [[next to]] Amy.
fix.tip: 身體特徵用 with；in 用於衣著

fix.t: The students [[in]] Ms. Lin's class [[is]] going to [[visit]] a museum tomorrow.
fix.tip: 主詞是 The students（複數），in 片語不影響 → are

fix.t: [[Every morning]], the girl [[with]] two little dogs [[walk]] in the park.
fix.tip: 主詞是 the girl（單數），不是 dogs → walks

fix.t: I [[want to]] make friends [[with]] a girl who [[speak]] French.
fix.tip: who 代替 a girl（單數）→ speaks

fix.t: The bridge which [[built]] [[in]] 1990 [[is]] still very strong.
fix.tip: 橋是「被」建造的，且在過去 → was built

fix.t: Anyone who [[want]] to join the club [[should]] [[fill out]] this form.
fix.tip: anyone 視為單數，who 後動詞 → wants

fix.t: The boy who [[lives]] [[across]] the street [[playing]] the piano every night.
fix.tip: 主詞 The boy 缺主要動詞，單數現在式 → plays

fix.t: Everyone [[loved]] the movie [[what]] [[was shown]] last night.
fix.tip: what 不能當關代修飾名詞，物用 that/which

fix.t: The bike [[which it]] is [[parked]] outside [[belongs to]] Ken.
fix.tip: which 已當子句主詞，不能再加 it

fix.t: We [[want to]] buy the house [[has]] a big garden [[near]] the park.
fix.tip: 已有動詞 buy；「有大花園的房子」用 with

fix.t: People who [[eats]] too much sugar [[often have]] bad teeth, so [[be careful]].
fix.tip: who 代替 People（複數）→ eat

fix.t: The color [[of]] her eyes [[are]] the same as [[her mother's]].
fix.tip: 主詞是 The color（單數），of her eyes 是修飾 → is

fix.t: I [[still remember]] the kind woman [[at the station]] who [[helps]] me yesterday.
fix.tip: yesterday 是過去時間 → helped

fix.t: [[This morning]], the teacher [[asked]] the boys who [[was]] late to clean the classroom.
fix.tip: who 代替 the boys（複數），過去式 → were

fix.t: My dog [[is]] afraid [[of]] the cats which [[lives]] next door.
fix.tip: which 代替 the cats（複數）→ live
